name: Checkout (made-up system for CRA2)
note: Synthetic. tier sets the risk thresholds; depends_on edges point at the services each one calls.

checkout-service.rollback: blue/green switch back to the previous release (about 2 min)
checkout-service.config_source: per-environment overrides in the config service, sometimes edited by hand during incidents

payment-gateway.rollback: abort the canary; rolling back processor-facing changes may need the card processor to re-certify
payment-gateway.config_source: per-region config files plus settings held by the card processor

auth-service.rollback: redeploy the previous image; tokens already issued stay valid until they expire

inventory-service.rollback: redeploy the previous image; schema changes need a reverse migration

order-service.rollback: blue/green switch back (about 2 min); schema changes need a reverse migration

notification-service.rollback: redeploy the previous image or scale back

web-frontend.rollback: point the CDN back at the previous static bundle (about 5 min)

mobile-frontend.rollback: turn the server-side flag off; app binaries already shipped cannot be rolled back
mobile-frontend.config_source: remote config keyed by app version
